description: This PHP trait provides helper functions for setting endpoints and related properties during dynamic endpoint resolution in the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes methods for applying endpoint URLs, headers, and HTTP schemes to requests.

methods.name: setEndpointV2RequestOptions
methods.description: Sets the endpoint, headers, and scheme for a request based on a resolved RulesetEndpoint object.

methods.name: applyHeaders
methods.description: Merges headers from the endpoint into the request headers if present.

methods.name: applyScheme
methods.description: Replaces the URL scheme in the resolved URL if a custom scheme is specified.
